availabilityPolicy: Verify exact native route before any candidate review. Any changed panel is recorded before reviewing any candidate, never selected in response to an unfavorable grade. No unauthorized paid fallback.

blinding.candidateId: fresh opaque identifier mapped privately to cell and exact commit
included: source base and candidate tree with ordinary doctrine
canonical source diff without commit author, message, branch or tool/model labels
source-grounded reuse references for the task
deterministic check verdict and bound receipt identifiers after independent code inspection
blinding.limits: Code style or integration artifacts may reveal provenance; judges record suspected unblinding separately. Do not rewrite candidate code to hide style.

anchors.1: Material defect; concrete violated contract, unsafe behavior, or fundamental missed abstraction.
anchors.2: Significant repair needed before acceptable Beep integration.
anchors.3: Acceptable for Beep; no material defect in the assessed dimension.
anchors.5: Exemplary, supported by concrete source evidence rather than absence of detected issues.

requiredPerDimension: brief file and line or diff-cited rationale
any finding with severity and remedy
reuseInstruction: Inspect actual existing schemas/helpers/services and package boundaries. Cite the existing symbol and candidate callsite or duplication. Do not penalize a necessary new abstraction merely because a similarly named symbol exists.
deterministicPriority: No grade or majority vote may turn failing task/package/full-Yeet evidence into a passing candidate. Preserve per-judge disagreements, never compress grades into one confidence score.
humanPanel: Operator grades top three full-verify-passing finalists per task plus documented close calls, with same blind packet and anchors. If fewer than three pass, show only qualifying finalists; failed close calls remain labeled failures.
recommendation: Compare each tool to no graph within the same model/task. Prioritize pass rate and quality/reuse, then observed time/tokens and preparation/upkeep. Show unknowns and failures, historical Graft preparation included/excluded, and declared ownership amortization horizons.
